sloka: एवं गृहीतेन कथं नु नाम शक्यं मया सम्प्रतिकर्तुमद्य।तथा करिष्यामि यथा हरीणां भविष्यतीष्टं च हितं च कार्यम् ।। ६.६७.८६ ।।
transliteration: evaṁ gṛhītena kathaṁ nu nāma śakyaṁ mayā sampratikartumadya।tathā kariṣyāmi yathā harīṇāṁ bhaviṣyatīṣṭaṁ ca hitaṁ ca kāryam ।। 6.67.86 ।।

translations.english: (Sugriva) being strong and painfully gained senses, from the arms of the great Rakshasa, started looking at the royal path of the city. He was bewildered and started pondering this way.
